goal: Rank by impact and recommend the safest mode for each

steps.rationale: Idle m5.large i-cross-stop, avg CPU 1.8% over 14d, all safety gates pass. Largest single saving; emit the stop-instances command.
Unattached 1000GB gp2 volume vol-cross-1, terraform-managed; route deletion through IaC PR.
NAT nat-cross-dev has hourly_only cost source (Flow Logs absent); observe-only with reassess pending data.

recommended_sequence.rationale: S3 Gateway is a candidate but no observed traffic data; enable Flow Logs and re-scan to quantify.

summary: Three steps across compute, storage, and network. Stop the idle m5.large (largest single win), PR the terraform-managed 1TB gp2 volume, surface the NAT as observe-only.
